thread:
sam: Starting onboarding for vega-18b weights. Uploaded to s3://redwood-models/vega/18b/v1/ — need a quick sanity-check for tokenizer and RoPE/window config before canary.

mara: on it. any known tokenizer quirks? emoji splitting? control tokens?

sam: Yes — seen emoji sequences get split across tokens in our current bpe mapping which causes generation drift on short prompts. Also tokenizer metadata included in s3: s3://redwood-models/vega/18b/v1/tokenizer.json

tj: I'll run a serve smoke on dev pool (pool-dev-rt-gpu) in ~15m. my script: ```./run_smoke.sh --weights s3://redwood-models/vega/18b/v1/weights.pt --pool pool-dev-rt-gpu --max-len 512``` will paste logs.

kevin: quick config note: model spec says GQA enabled by default; MQA fallback exists. For 4k effective window we need rotary_scale ~= 1.25. If we leave rotary_scale=1.0 we see hallucination after ~600 tokens in our emulation.

mara: thanks. can you propose a safe override we can land in the serve config?

kevin: propose patch: ```serve_config: { "gqa": true, "mqa": "auto", "rotary_scale": 1.25, "sliding_window": { "enabled": true, "ttl_s": 30 }, "kv_prefetch": false }``` This keeps TTL low for stateful chat and disables kv_prefetch to avoid window edge duplication during rollouts.

infra-bot: checksum OK — manifest sha256: 3a7c9f2e...f9b1. weights size: 186GB. tags: [vega-18b, v1, onboard]

sam: tj, any smoke logs?

tj: smoke passed on CPU path, GPU trace shows runtime warning about attention impl fallback: "fallback to generic_attention for block sizes > 1024" — copying snippet:
``
W runtime: attention_kernel_fallback.cpp: line 214 - block_size 2048 > optimized_limit 1024, fallback engaged
```

kevin: that's the attention impl guard. For MQA/GQA combined with 4k windows we hit block_size > optimized_limit. Two options: 1) bump optimized kernel or 2) set sliding_window max_chunk to 1024. Kernel bump is higher risk; recommend option 2 for canary.

mara: agree. set sliding_window.chunk_size = 1024 in canary, log metrics for token_confidence and latency. If everything green, we'll lift after kernel update.

mj: I'll open PR to set rotary_scale and chunk_size with feature flag `vega18b_rope_safe` and add tokenizer special-case for emoji. PR #4892. tagging @kevin @tj for review.

sam: perfect. I'll schedule canary for pool-dev-rt-gpu tomorrow 09:00 PST. adding notes to the onboarding checklist.

oncall-bot: reminder — please add rollback playbook to the canary runbook: https://confluence.redwood/rollbacks/vega-18b

sam: done. thanks everyone :pray:
